items.q: Where are the protons found in an atom?
items.qAf: Waar word die protone in ’n atoom gevind?
items.explain: Protons and neutrons are in the nucleus at the centre; electrons move around it.
items.explainAf: Protone en neutrone is in die kern in die middel; elektrone beweeg rondom dit.

items.q: What is the charge of an electron?
items.qAf: Wat is die lading van ’n elektron?
items.explain: Electrons carry a negative charge, protons a positive charge, and neutrons no charge.
items.explainAf: Elektrone dra ’n negatiewe lading, protone ’n positiewe lading, en neutrone geen lading nie.

items.q: An atom has 8 protons and 8 electrons. What is its overall charge?
items.qAf: ŉ Atoom het 8 protone en 8 elektrone. Wat is sy totale lading?
items.explain: Equal numbers of positive protons and negative electrons cancel out, so the atom is neutral.
items.explainAf: Gelyke getalle positiewe protone en negatiewe elektrone hef mekaar op, so die atoom is neutraal.

items.q: Which atomic model shows electrons moving in fixed orbits around the nucleus?
items.qAf: Watter atoommodel wys elektrone wat in vaste bane om die kern beweeg?
items.explain: Bohr’s model places electrons in energy levels, or shells, around the nucleus.
items.explainAf: Bohr se model plaas elektrone in energievlakke, of skille, om die kern.

items.q: An atom has atomic number 11 and mass number 23. How many neutrons does it have?
items.qAf: ŉ Atoom het atoomgetal 11 en massagetal 23. Hoeveel neutrone het dit?

items.q: Which number tells you how many protons an atom has?
items.qAf: Watter getal sê vir jou hoeveel protone ’n atoom het?
items.explain: The atomic number is the number of protons in the nucleus, and it identifies the element.
items.explainAf: Die atoomgetal is die aantal protone in die kern, en dit identifiseer die element.
